run_label: ac/engine/observe — sf_motor operator spectrum, sensitivity, and loop work

build.reason: /home/sungwook/ffn_ac_native is not a git repository; the commit is the caller's assertion and was not verified here

evidence_basis: the tangent and the force of the nmii_sf_motor slice were both applied on cuda:0 and the 2712-DOF operator was assembled by column probing; every mechanical parameter is an unresolved KB/PI GAP, so the spectrum is quotable as a STRUCTURE (counts, ratios, decades, localisation) and no eigenvalue is quotable as a stress-fiber material property

config.detach_kinetics_note: the detach hazard does NOT enter the tangent; SLIP is used so no unsourced catch-slip proxy constant is introduced by an observer

motor_station_census.exclusion_reason: curved sarcomere (mid is an arch apex, not the chord midpoint): the two filaments are not collinear over the shared span, so a rigid bipolar minifilament cannot straddle them

parameter_provenance.k_axial: PI_GAP (card S1 — NF2007 treats the backbone as inextensible; the axial penalty is a model choice)
parameter_provenance.backbone_lp: PI_GAP (card N — NMII backbone persistence length)
parameter_provenance.alpha_actinin_arc: SOURCED (Ferrer 2008 alpha-actinin), entering as the dorsal<->arc crosslink

t0.note: measured BEFORE the first accepted step; no head bound, so the crossbridge family must contribute exactly nothing to the tangent

timing.device_note: NOT a benchmark. This driver takes no physical-time steps beyond the 10 binding steps, so no real-time factor is meaningful; the cost is dominated by column probing (one operator application per DOF, x2 configurations x9 stiffness families) and two dense eigensolves. Warp kernel COMPILATION is included when the cache is cold, which on the first run of an edited kernel dominates everything else.
timing.comparable_against: another run whose gate also PASSED under the same contract and observable; a cost is only a cost at a stated convergence

cfl_vs_measured.explicit_step_left_on_the_table: an explicit step sized by the Gershgorin bound is smaller than the stability limit by exactly this factor
cfl_vs_measured.caveat: lambda_min_nonzero sits within a small multiple of the eigensolve's own resolvability floor, so the reported condition number is a LOWER bound on the true one

minifilament_internal_floppiness.why_this_form: a per-object count transfers to any population containing the object; a fraction of the slice's own DOF does not, and the fraction form was retired on 2026-07-28 for exactly that reason
minifilament_internal_floppiness.participation_is_basis_dependent: the internal null space is DEGENERATE (every direction in it has the same eigenvalue, zero), so it has no canonical basis and the per-mode participation figure describes the arbitrary basis the eigensolver returned, NOT the object. What is basis-independent, and therefore what may be quoted, is the SUBSPACE: its dimension, and the fraction of it that lies on the head particles
minifilament_internal_floppiness.what_this_does_not_test: that each internal direction is one head rotating about its own arm. The dimension being one short of the head count, and the weight sitting on the heads, is consistent with that reading — but a degenerate subspace cannot be decomposed into per-head modes without a further measurement this run does not make

sensitivity.observable: the 2207 lowest RESOLVABLE eigenvalues of K at the measured configuration, selected by a fixed baseline index set — a field, not a summary scalar

analytic_cross_check.identity: d(log lambda_i)/d(log theta_j) = theta_j * u_i^T K_j u_i / lambda_i
analytic_cross_check.caveat: the analytic identity holds for SIMPLE eigenvalues; near-degenerate eigenvalues are not individually differentiable, so the worst-case entry is expected to sit far above the bulk and the distribution is the informative comparison

non_conservative_attribution.question: is the bound field's circulation produced by the crossbridge, or by the configuration the run moved to?
non_conservative_attribution.control: the SAME configuration with every head detached and the binding SoA restored bit-for-bit afterwards; exactly one thing differs between the two
non_conservative_attribution.consequence_if_attributed: the crossbridge force is not a gradient, so no potential exists for the composed field and an energy ledger for this lane MUST carry an active-work term; the measured circulation per circuit IS that term's first direct measurement. It also means the symmetric tangent the implicit solve uses is a quasi-Newton operator by construction: it omits the crossbridge's non-symmetric position dependence, which is legitimate for locating a fixed point but bounds the convergence RATE

gate_as_first_declared.predicate: tangent symmetric AND loop verdict == 'quadrature' AT THE BOUND CONFIGURATION
gate_as_first_declared.why_it_was_mis_specified: it asserts that a force field containing bound myosin crossbridges is conservative; an active motor injects work, so a nonzero circulation there is the physics, not a defect
gate_as_first_declared.status: PI sign-off pending — this is a gate-contract scope change

gate.void_ceiling_rationale: an antisymmetric part above 1% of the tangent's own largest entry leaves no separable conservative structure: at that level the operator is not a Hessian of anything, so a PASS would be a statement about round-off and a FAIL a statement about nothing

notes.configuration_of_the_bound_probe: the accepted-step run's reached configuration after 10 steps, NOT an equilibrium; a tangent is well defined there, but nothing about the equilibrium may be inferred from its spectrum
notes.why_the_gate_reads_the_tangent: symmetry of the tangent is exactly the integrability condition for F = -grad U and carries no quadrature error, so it is the primary conservativity observable; the loop integral corroborates it from the force side and its residual is identified by its own amplitude/segment scaling rather than against a chosen tolerance
